explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 96 named tracks across roughly twenty releases in Hard Wax's current-arrivals page: current techno compilations and releases, adjacent/emerging bass/dub/experimental labels, and overlooked Music Man/Sähkö catalogue material. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Hard Wax current arrivals, including HYS007 and Carrier — Thresholds, checked 2026-09-13. https://hardwax.com/

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Carrier, Ruff Kutz, Nullpunkt, Erik Jabari, Samurai Music and Mole Audio bass/dub/experimental releases, with exact Bandcamp/Eastern Bloc corroboration where available. https://hardwax.com/ ; https://d-b-1.bandcamp.com/ ; https://www.easternblocrecords.com/
OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: Music Man's Ignacio remaster and Sähkö's Ø — Metri catalogue material. https://hardwax.com/
exclusions: Completed Runs 210, 211, 213 and 214 plus Run 209's selected identities and source fields were excluded; failed Run 212 identities were not reused.

Every exact artist/title pair below was checked against the canonical ledger, target discoveries, local discovery pool, active rejections, PARKED revisit queue and global utility ledger before ranking; none was present.
The repetition check compared the previous five completed discovery runs (209, 210, 211, 213 and 214). None of the nine placements repeats a selected-candidate boundary from those runs.

Nine honest leads survived without padding. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, invented identity or metadata-to-feeling inference was used.
